title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf Korea Pairing
items.text: Talor Gooch was paired with Bryson DeChambeau and Cam Smith during the third round of LIV Golf Korea on Saturday.

items.headline: PGA Tour Thin Field
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gained leverage as the PGA Tour's Charles Schwab Challenge at Colonial has only one top-10 OWGR player in the field.

items.headline: McIlroy’s Putting Advice
items.text: At the 2024 Genesis Invitational, Rory McIlroy advised Scottie Scheffler to switch to a mallet-style putter for a better margin of error.
